reason: The cited evidence shows thermomechanical treatment improves room-temperature ductility in Ti-rich MEAs (E3, E4) and that a different alloy system has good 600°C strength via precipitates (E2), but none of the passages demonstrate that thermomechanical treatment of a Ti-Ni HEA improves elevated-temperature strength or corrosion resistance, nor that it produces grain refinement and defect reduction in this system.
premises: Thermomechanical treatment can refine grains and reduce defects in Ti-containing MEAs
Grain refinement and defect reduction improve yield strength and ultimate tensile strength
Thermomechanical treatment improves elevated-temperature mechanical properties
A single BCC structure can be achieved and maintained after thermomechanical treatment
